menteVisionaria.biasHeading: Bias alert of the day (avoid scale mistakes)

recurrence.title: Recency of a spike
recurrence.body: A signal that rose today is not a guarantee it will last. Check consistency before you scale.

fomo.title: FOMO bias
fomo.body: Are you picking this niche from the data, or from the fear of missing out?

herd.title: Herd bias
herd.body: Everyone mining the same niche does not mean there is still room for you.

confirmation.title: Confirmation bias
confirmation.body: Are you only collecting evidence that supports the decision you already made?

recency.title: Recency bias
recency.body: The last launch you saw weighs more than the weekly average. Read the series, not the last point.

sunk.title: Sunk cost
sunk.body: Hours and money already spent do not justify staying in a saturated niche. What matters is the next step.

overconfidence.title: Overconfidence
overconfidence.body: A Hot card is not a guarantee. High confidence on Radar still needs evidence and saturation.

availability.title: Availability bias
availability.body: The niche that shows up most in your feed is not necessarily the most viable. Mentions ≠ opportunity.

anchoring.title: Anchoring
anchoring.body: The first number you saw (score, commission, trend) does not have to be the only criterion.

fatigue.title: Decision fatigue
fatigue.body: Too many cards, too little pause. If the mind is tired, delay the niche choice until after the Neuro-Check.

scarcity.title: False scarcity
scarcity.body: “Last slot” and “everyone is entering” are triggers. Check whether the signal is still Early.

authority.title: Authority bias
authority.body: A guru, group or ranking does not replace Radar data. Cross source, saturation and consistency.

outcome.title: Outcome bias
outcome.body: One affiliate won in niche X. That does not prove the window is still open for you.

survivorship.title: Survivorship bias
survivorship.body: You see who scaled. You almost never see who saturated and left. Ask for the denominator, not only the winners.

checklist.title: Mining-bias decoder
checklist.subtitle: A quick checklist before you enter a niche. Nothing is saved — it is only for you to hear yourself.
checklist.ok: Good. Most answers point to a data-led decision, not an impulse.
checklist.warn: Consider reviewing the data before you decide. Most answers show emotional bias or no plan B.
checklist.complete: Checklist complete. You reviewed every bias checkpoint.

q1.prompt: Are you picking this signal because the data shows consistency over days, or because it showed up as Hot now?
q1.bias: Only because it is Hot now

q2.prompt: Did you validate recent signal volume, or are you trusting the status label alone?

q3.prompt: If this niche saturates in 2 weeks, would you have a plan B?

q4.prompt: Is the choice coming from Radar numbers or from the fear of missing out?

q5.prompt: Did you look at niche saturation (Hot / Moderate / Saturated) before imagining scale?

neuro.title: Resilience thermometer
neuro.question: How is your mind for deciding today?
neuro.stressWarning: Your stress level is high. Avoid changing campaign budgets in the next 2 hours so you do not act on impulse.
neuro.chartHint: Last 14 days. Gold = great · cyan = neutral · yellow = anxious · red = stressed.
